topic: Data cleanup, loading, and forecasting for Japan
summary_markdown:
The session focused on data maintenance tasks for a Japanese campaign. Initial steps involved deleting old device session records across two facilities (44296 and 44295) for company 7957, spanning from November 8, 2024, to May 1, 2025. Multiple attempts were made to run these deletion queries, which caused significant database load and slowdowns.

After the data was successfully reloaded (for both facilities), a forecast was requested for the newly loaded sessions. The forecasting process was completed by [me] using the dates provided (November 9, 2024 - November 15, 2024) as the basis for projection.

The session concluded with confirmation that the data loading and subsequent forecasting were completed for both `device_session_trusted` and `device_session` tables.
decisions: Old device session records for facilities 44296 and 44295 (company 7957) spanning Nov 8, 2024 - May 1, 2025 were deleted/cleaned up.
New data was loaded into the system for both specified facilities.
A forecast was generated based on the newly loaded session data.
